title: birds.cafe: a browser experience where you steer a flock of seagulls through day, night
description:
No missions, no score, no stress. birds.cafe just lets you fly. It's a relaxing browser experience where you steer a flock of seagulls in V-formation out over the ocean, through day, night, rain, storms, and lightning, with ambient music underneath. Built in Three.js with physics-based flight, the flock actually holds formation behind you, and it runs smooth on mobile with touch controls.

https://github.com/kanavtwtgg/birds.cafe
